game_title: Function Test Arena – Ice Mill Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frost imps.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frost imps. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about tests_passed to power up the frost mage and open the wall banner.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ice Mill'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
